description: This file defines the 'Cheque' class, a controller for the cheque payment extension in the OpenCart admin system. It handles displaying the settings form, loading configuration, and saving updates related to the cheque payment method.

classes.name: Cheque
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'Cheque' payment extension settings in the admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration form for the cheque payment method, populating data with current settings and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to save the cheque payment extension settings, validating permissions and returning JSON response.
